Physical, occupational, speech, habilitative and rehabilitative therapy

We cover up to 60 outpatient therapy visits per person per calendar year for the combined services when a physician: • orders the care; • identifies the specific professional skills the patient requires and the medical necessity for skilled services; and • indicates the length of time the services are needed. Notes: • Inpatient therapy services are not applied to the visit limits, see Section 5(c), Inpatient hospital • Rehabilitative and Habilitative therapy, see Section 10, Definitions of Terms
